title: Still thinking of the very unpleasant scene at Westland Row terminus when it was perfectly evident that the other two, Mulligan, that is, and that English tourist friend of his, who eventually euchred their third companion, were patently trying, as if the whole bally station belonged to them, to give Stephen the slip in the confusion.
html_source: In Oxen in the Sun, Mulligan agrees to meet Haines and Stephen at the train station to catch the last train back to Sandycove, with Buck still holding the key to the Martello tower. Something happens at the station, however, according to a remark in Circe, that leaves Stephen with a hurt hand and no train home.
